name: foresee
description: Shop for home and auto insurance with live carrier quotes. Instant filing-based estimates plus Foresee agents that complete the carriers' own quote flows — with the user's explicit consent — and read back the real page premium.

interface.shortDescription: Compare auto insurance quotes across carriers.
interface.longDescription: Instant filing-based auto quotes from carriers' rate manuals, plus live premiums read back from the carriers' own quote flows with the user's explicit consent. Estimates are not bindable quotes; purchase finishes on the carrier's quoting portal.
defaultPrompt: How much would auto insurance cost for a 25-year-old driving a 2022 Camry in Sacramento?
Compare carriers for my profile and say who is cheapest at a $1000 deductible.
What does 100/300 mean, and what would raising my collision deductible save?
